description:
That grey tower near your colony that has looked half-built for years may already belong to hundreds of families.
In 2022 about 4.8 lakh homes in India's seven biggest cities were stuck or running very late, and about half of them were in Delhi NCR. In projects that stopped completely, roughly two out of three flats had already been sold. Many of those buyers pay a home loan EMI and house rent every month while they wait. A government fund started in 2019 had helped finish about 61,000 such homes by December 2025.
Is there a building like this in your town? How long has it been standing like that?
#homebuyers
